_comment: Errands given by agents. The engine owns them: state lives in the character's storage, items and gold come only from these definitions, never from a model. A step runs at one agent, moves the state from 'from' to 'to' and applies its effects, all or nothing. words: what a player says at that agent to ask for the step (normalised ASCII, whole phrases). Read by Lua and Brain; copied to the server by scripts/sync-server.ps1. say: the fixed line spoken with a step, because a player must understand what to do next; notice: what the engine tells the player.

steps.say: Kochanienki, zanies ten list do Broma, {name}. Stoi przy starym posterunku, po polnocnej stronie placu. Potem wroc do mnie.
O, list od Miry! Dzieki, {name}. Wroc do niej i powiedz, ze dotarl.
Dziekuje ci, {name}. Dobrze wiedziec, ze mozna na tobie polegac.

refused.no_capacity: Nie uniesiesz tego, {name}. Zrob miejsce w plecaku.
